verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs the Docker images you supply as VMs and can use your existing Dockerfile, so code targets standard Linux and container runtimes rather than a proprietary edge runtime. Its managed database is standard PostgreSQL. However, the evidence never explicitly frames this as cross-platform portability or standard edge runtime APIs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of portability across other edge platforms, standards-based storage APIs beyond Postgres (e.g. S3-compatible object storage), and independent hands-on corroboration that code runs unmodified elsewhere.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs

citations.quote: We build Machines out of the images you give us and we run them where you tell us to.
Fly.io converts Docker images to fast-booting VMs and runs them globally.
If your project already has one, Fly Launch can use it instead.
Fly.io's Managed Postgres is our fully-managed database service that handles all aspects of running production PostgreSQL databases
